hack.root_cause: Admin Privilege Abuse — Bridge Role Minting Unbacked Collateral
hack.description: An attacker who was granted Admin + Bridge roles on Credix's ACLManager six days before the exploit used the bridge minting function to fabricate $4.5M in phantom collateral, then borrowed all real liquidity from the protocol.
